· Works directly with three founders to turn evolving priorities into shipped features across analysis, architecture, web/mobile development, evaluation, and operations.

through parallel provider calls, result aggregation, selective Redis caching, and Celery tasks to accelerate asset and vault queries.

through automated flow evaluations and controls against malicious instructions; removing redundant queries yielded an estimated
30% reduction in tokens associated with unnecessary queries
Integrated Morpho, Aave, and Compound end to end
for positions, yields, deposits, and withdrawals across backend, frontend, and transaction execution, with completeness checks and webhook-based status tracking.
Refactored the product around hexagonal architecture and a design system
to reuse components; developed React Native/Kotlin features and validated them through automated tests, emulators, and real devices.
Cut validation, build, and deployment from approximately 1 hour to 10 minutes
while retaining checks and optimizing the bundle. Prepared DigitalOcean infrastructure for growth toward thousands of users, with containers, databases, monitoring, and backups.
Automated local setup with Makefile and Infisical
and a reusable development-agent skills catalog, standardizing environments, per-user access, and secrets synchronization with on-demand rotation.
Payway promotions platform
— contributed as a key engineering team member to a complete historical load of
20M+ promotions in production
and the ingestion of thousands of new promotions per day, within an ecosystem of 350,000+ merchants, 70+ card issuers, and 13 countries.
Delivered the promotions experience end to end
: integrated a Single-SPA React/TypeScript microfrontend through a Spring WebFlux BFF and used Amazon API Gateway to bridge the HTTPS merchant portal with internal HTTP services.
Built Java/Spring Boot and TypeScript/Node.js/NestJS microservices
using hexagonal or layered architecture, and developed and diagnosed containerized workloads running in Docker/Kubernetes-managed environments.
Implemented event-driven processing
with S3, SQS, and a Python/FastAPI Lambda for the historical load; built Python/Node.js tooling to reproduce local loads, reconcile results, and identify failed promotions.
Designed a merchant-facing RAG assistant
with Python, LangChain, LangGraph, PostgreSQL/pgvector, and guardrails for active/expired promotions and statistics, without executing commercial actions.
Created a custom agentic engineering workspace
for the product's multi-repository integration landscape to streamline context retrieval, token usage, and consistent feature delivery.
Independent Product Engineering
· Revenue-generating products, internal operations systems, and AI automation for e-commerce, social media, and digital-product clients.
Designed and shipped digital products
, back offices, and stock/point-of-sale extensions that generated
USD 10,000+ in cumulative client profit
, connecting commercial needs with maintainable, scalable operations.
Built MCP-, Claude-, and LLM-powered pipelines and agents
for end-to-end content research, generation, and publishing; clients estimated operating-cost reductions of at least

using Spec-Driven Development, cutting tasks from hours to minutes. For
Pequeverso
, delivered a Next.js site on Hostinger and an informational product and shopping assistant.

150+ branches
2.7M+ members
, and 50+ internal systems.
Built a responsive, dynamic Next.js/TypeScript frontend
connected exclusively to a Python/FastAPI BFF, which centralized the back-office contract and decoupled the UI from downstream microservices and integrations.
Integrated 10+ systems
through Java/Spring Boot and TypeScript/Node.js/NestJS microservices with a shared permissions contract; built an agentic development workspace to preserve context across repositories.
Standardized system onboarding
with reusable structures, filters, and validation, reducing permission-related tickets and manual assignments by at least
and eliminating at least
of recurring assignment bugs, based on before/after tickets and logs.

through the integrated back office, SQL tuning, indexing, and pagination. Critical endpoints averaged under
300 ms
in tests on enterprise on-premise servers.
Implemented LDAP, RBAC, and exportable auditing
to restrict access to authorized personnel; automated Python validation and bulk loads for a MySQL/MariaDB and Redis system subsequently maintained by the web team.
Graduated
